# Risheek Nawka

> Risheek Nawka is a 19-year-old creative technologist applying to the a16z Horowitz Academy founding class. Tagline: "I build things where art and technology meet." Key facts: Founder, Summer and Solse; Consulted for Adobe; 7 creative-tech projects shipped; Gap year, building full-time.

This site is an interactive portfolio. The click-through "story" is animated and has little readable text; every fact is also available as plain text below.

## Read this
- [Full portfolio as Markdown](https://risheeknawka.com/portfolio.md): every achievement in order, with the key number for each
- [Structured data (JSON)](https://risheeknawka.com/portfolio.json): the same facts, machine-readable
- [Index page](https://risheeknawka.com/#/index): the fast, readable overview in the browser
- [Solse case study](https://risheeknawka.com/#/solse): Software that learns your brand. Mona (ads) and Luce (product testing); the full text is at the end of portfolio.md
